qualification: Planning and dry run only. No provider call, no key, no network request, no runtime read.

AG-S1.smallestLiveObservation: One call on a public development input passes the gateway with the PostgreSQL ledger: reserved, dispatched, settled, and the answer fits its closed schema.
AG-S1.producedBy: ModelGateway.propose, reached through extractStoreyFacts; started by scripts/agent/live-proof.ts --live
AG-S1.sent: Step 1 of the plan: the storey lines of one development sanction document, each cut to 240 characters.
AG-S1.dataClassAndPermission: public, development, permission unconfirmed; recorded in the storey-truth dev record and docs/api/datasets.json (rera-storeys)
AG-S1.receiptMustContain: ledger call id and state settled, HTTP status, response hash, input and output tokens, actual micro-INR, price version, policy hash, served commit
AG-S1.liveCallCannotGive: Nothing further; the ledger row itself is read by the runtime owner.

AG-S2.smallestLiveObservation: The recording of that answer is found by its replay key and returned as replayed, with no reservation and no dispatch.
AG-S2.receiptMustContain: the recording's request hash equal to the planned one, replayed true, zero provider calls, ledger rows unchanged
AG-S2.liveCallCannotGive: An answer that fails validation is recorded and charged but is not replayable.

ML-D1.smallestLiveObservation: The storey agent answers on the retained development and demo page stores, and its quote-checked values are compared per field with the rule baseline.
ML-D1.producedBy: extractStoreyFacts (ai/document-storey-agent.ts); afterwards, offline, storeys/a5/verify-candidates.ts and score.py
ML-D1.sent: Per document one request: the OCR or text-layer lines that name a storey, floor, unit or height, each cut to 240 characters, with page and line id. No image, no whole page.
ML-D1.dataClassAndPermission: public RERA and sanction documents, development or demo, permission unconfirmed; recorded in each storey-truth record and docs/api/datasets.json
ML-D1.receiptMustContain: per document the state, attempts, the output file, and the per-field comparison with its denominators
ML-D1.liveCallCannotGive: The comparison is an offline step after the run. Two Tower 3 plan documents cannot be sent as they are (see gaps).

ML-D3.smallestLiveObservation: The development answers are scored against the registry fields that exist: floor expression (7 literals) and unit count (4 known).
ML-D3.producedBy: the three development calls of ML-D1, then storeys/a5/score.py
ML-D3.sent: The development documents of ML-D1 only.
ML-D3.receiptMustContain: precision and recall per field with n, abstentions, and null where the registry is blank
ML-D3.liveCallCannotGive: Independent floor-label truth; a score where the official unit count is blank; any held-out agent score, because held-out documents never go to a teacher.

ML-L2.smallestLiveObservation: On two similar development files the paid calls per chunk are counted: one on the first chunk of a header layout, none on the next chunks, with questions and unanswered fields beside them.
ML-L2.sent: Per new header layout one request: per column the masked header, inferred type, value shapes and up to 5 masked samples. No row.
ML-L2.dataClassAndPermission: public, development (family mi-d10), permission unconfirmed; recorded in fixtures/usp/D8-messy-india/manifest.json and docs/api/datasets.json
ML-L2.receiptMustContain: per chunk: paid calls, replay asks, reuse, student fields, unanswered fields, questions, candidate cells
ML-L2.liveCallCannotGive: Precision on committed fields needs committed positives and an independent truth. A fall on the second file's first chunk needs an officer-approved plan in accepted memory or a student that commits every column; this run approves nothing.

AG-D1.smallestLiveObservation: A recorded storey answer becomes proposals on the existing document-proposal route, and an accept or reject decision reads back.
AG-D1.producedBy: Not on staging at e4623944: the adapter beside the storey agent is another worker's task.
AG-D1.sent: Nothing new: the ML-D1 recordings are its input and replay at no cost.
AG-D1.receiptMustContain: proposal ids, the decision, the read-back, the served commit
AG-D1.liveCallCannotGive: The route receipt. A live call supplies only the agent answer.

AG-E2.smallestLiveObservation: One JSON that separates paid calls, replay asks, reuse, student fields and unanswered fields per chunk for two files.
AG-E2.receiptMustContain: the per-chunk rows of ML-L2 for both files
AG-E2.liveCallCannotGive: Committed-field accuracy; the receipt reports n as it is.

tokenMethod.tokenizer: none for sarvam-105b in this repository
tokenMethod.inputEstimate: bytes of the body the gateway measures (messages, schema, model, output maximum) divided by 3
tokenMethod.inputEstimateError: not measured: 3 bytes per token is an assumption until the first receipt gives the ratio
tokenMethod.inputUpperBound: body bytes + 2048, the gateway's own admission rule (one token per byte at worst)
tokenMethod.outputEstimate: half the configured output maximum; reasoning tokens are billed as output
tokenMethod.outputUpperBound: the configured output maximum (max_tokens in the request)
tokenMethod.held: the ledger's reservation per call: the bound's prompt maximum and the output maximum, plus the cushion
tokenMethod.paise: every rupee figure is rounded up to the next paisa

stopRules: Every call is one attempt: no repair call, no retry, never another key.
The run stops at the first refusal by the gateway, the first HTTP 402 or quota answer, the first rate limit, the first timeout or unknown outcome, and the first answer that could not be recorded.
It stops before a call when holding it at the full reservation would cross the total, daily, per-person or document-agent cap, counting every earlier call at its reservation.
After a stop every later step asks the replay store only, ends in needs_input or teacher_unavailable when nothing is recorded, and its receipt says afterStop.
An answer that fails validation is charged, recorded and reported as a result; it is not replayable.

gaps: Tower 3 plan 1 and plan 2 cannot be sent as they are: a line starting with a square bracket makes minimizeStructuredText refuse the request. The fix is in the storey agent's line preparation or the minimizer, outside this task's paths.
The estimate's token ratio (3 bytes per token) and the output estimate (half the maximum) are assumptions; the first live receipt replaces them.
The plan assumes an empty ledger and cold memory; it does not read the runtime ledger, accepted memory or recordings.
The live mode was written and never started. How the demo profile's environment reaches that process is for the runtime owner's task file.
The live receipt takes tokens and cost from the recording; the ledger call id is read from PostgreSQL by the runtime owner.
The proposal's input bound (34816) and pace (1500 ms) are the schema's smallest values, not approved bounds.

report.TASK: S1 — The first approved Sarvam run, planned to the call and to the rupee, and a dry run that sends nothing. GATE AG-S1, AG-S2, ML-D1, ML-D3, ML-L2, AG-D1, AG-E2
WORKS: 8 calls; estimate ₹0.95, at most ₹6.20 of the ₹100 proposed (lead's proposal, not approved); closes boxes AG-S1, AG-S2, AG-E2 and, after offline scoring, ML-D1; cannot close AG-D1 (no agent-to-proposal adapter on staging), ML-D3's independent label truth, or ML-L2's precision (no committed n).

The dry run walks all 13 steps: 9 gateway asks, 0 provider dispatches, 0 ledger reservations, 0 fetch attempts, 8 of 8 requests equal to the planned hash; every step ends needs_input or teacher_unavailable.
report.INPUTS: good: mi-d10-01.csv and mi-d10-02.csv plus six development or demo storey page stores; difficult: the two Tower 3 plan page stores, refused offline with MODEL_PROMPT_PRIVACY

DESIGN: scripts/agent/live-proof.ts: orderedSteps() builds every request with mappingTeacherRequest and storeyRequest, sizes it as gateway.ts measures it, prices it with pricing.ts cost() and reservation(), and asks capAdmission() in the ledger's order.
runSequence() is one walk for both modes; dryRunDrivers() gives it a ModelGateway over a ReplayAdapter and a counting ledger double, liveDrivers() the runtime gateway behind assertLiveStart().
The tariff is a whole gateway policy parsed by ModelGatewayConfigSchema, so tariff.policyHash is the hash that status prints; docs/backend/LIVE-PROOF.md is the page for the day.
